description: Renovate is the only dependency updater for this repository. Dependabot updates are disabled; its passive alerts stay on because vulnerabilityAlerts reads them (OSV covers direct dependencies only). Policy carried over from the former .github/dependabot.yml; see SPEC A63.

packageRules.description: Group every docs/ npm update into one weekly PR, like the former docs-dependencies group.
@astrojs/check 0.9.x declares a TypeScript ^5 || ^6 peer range, so TypeScript 7 cannot install yet.
CodeQL init and analyze must move together.
SPEC R13: the browser lane stays on Ubuntu 22.04 for Chromium's sandbox; runner images change only by explicit task.
raylib and Emscripten must stay compatible: review them together.

customManagers.description: Versions annotated with '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' on the line above a 'NAME: value' entry.
The raylib tag and its immutable commit in the shared composite action.
